document.body: Final acceptance body — created, edited, reloaded, and persisted across backend restart.

gates.observed: Host session established issuer context; client, principal, workspace, expiry and capabilities were validated; backend auth and GraphQL workspace read-back returned 200 and semantic health was healthy.
Compiled AFFiNE mounted into the host block target on the non-root workspace route; DOM contained no iframe and no donor login/marketing/download chrome.
A uniquely named document was created and its title and body were edited in the fresh positive browser context; host health remained healthy.
Browser reload returned All docs, the unique title/body were found, the document was reopened, and both inline editors matched the saved values.
Backend wrapper 95831 was terminated; wrapper 50454 and listener 50486 served port 3012; reload/find/reopen returned the same unique title/body with healthy semantic health.
Positive browser network captured issuer 200, backend auth/GraphQL/document 200, nested module paths, and 30 nested font requests with 200; no root /fonts failure occurred.
Worker asset loaded at the nested module path; generated worker JavaScript contains the backend request/socket bridge and the completed CRUD workflow depended on it.
gates.held: A separate worker-only request/response trace was not captured by the browser CLI and remains unproven.

gates.observed: Fresh wrong-workspace context rendered Workspace denied, made no issuer/backend API request, and showed no donor login/chrome; console had zero errors and warnings.

Settings revoke action returned the host to Knowledge; context fetch then failed closed as Block error / 401. Direct missing and revoked issuer context/session and donor auth-method probes all returned 401.
Positive, wrong-workspace and revoked terminal states presented no donor sign-in/login/download/marketing surface; the host owns the only tested session/revoke action.

Host and SDK regression tests prove donor unmount observes populated DOM before host clearing; clearing occurs in finally and session revoke follows teardown. Browser route teardown produced no removeChild crash.
Fresh positive browser context completed final create/edit/reload/restart flow with zero console errors and zero warnings.
